title: Chef Tini’s Viral Mac & Cheese
ingredients: ½ tsp freshly ground black or white pepper
instructions: Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C) and grease a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Boil cavatappi in salted water until al dente (about 1–2 minutes under package directions). Drain and set aside.
Hand-grate all three cheeses and mix them together in a large bowl. Divide into two equal halves (one half for sauce, one half for layering and topping).
Combine garlic powder, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper in a small bowl.
Melt 3 tbsp butter in a large pot or deep skillet over medium heat. Stir in half of the seasoning mix to bloom the spices.
Sprinkle in 3 tbsp all-purpose flour and whisk continuously for 1 to 2 minutes to cook out raw flour taste.
Slowly stream in the 12 oz can of evaporated milk while whisking constantly. Pour in the 2 cups heavy cream, remaining seasoning mix, and 1 tbsp Dijon mustard. Whisk gently until smooth and bubbling.
Turn heat to low. Add half of the total shredded cheese gradually, one handful at a time, whisking until velvety.
Remove from heat and gently fold the cooked cavatappi into the cheese sauce until fully coated.
Spread half of the cheesy pasta into the prepared baking dish. Sprinkle half of the reserved cheese over the layer.
Add remaining pasta, then top with the rest of the cheese blend.
Bake at 350°F for 25–30 minutes until bubbly around the edges. Broil for 2 minutes to get a golden-brown blistered top.
notes: Exact recipe from @Tiniyounger. Hand-grating block cheese rather than using pre-shredded cheese is critical to avoid graininess from cellulose coatings.
